title: RFSensorMasterList
description: This is configuration that is used to validate settings by matching a sensor's name against its expected model. It is a file that is supplied in addition to the measurement RFSweepConfiguration.

RFSOURCES.description: RF Sources used to produce a signal.

CALORIMETERS.description: Names of commercial mounts that just produce a power reading.

COMMERCIAL_MOUNTS.description: Names of commercial mounts that just produce a power reading.

SPECIAL_MOUNTS.description: Names of special mounts that have no sensing element.

THIN_FILM_MOUNTS.description: Names of thinfilm mounts that require a PTC feedback loop.

THERMISTOR_MOUNTS.description: Name of thermistor mounts that require an NTC feedback loop

KEYSIGHT_THERMOPILE_BALANCE_MOUNTS.description: Name of keysight balance mounts are not operated with a feedback loop.

EXPECTED_RESISTANCE.description: Key-value pairs of every sensor and what they're resistance should be (if applicable).

EXPECTED_LINEAR_TERM_BOUNDS.description: Key-value pairs of the expected linear term of the thermoelectric sensor in volts per watts.
